content:
All four directions report "nothing there" — the notice board is never in front of me because it's on my own tile. E can't target it.

Let me think about this differently. The notice board "blocks" and is at my exact tile. In this game engine, maybe a blocking object on your tile means you're "inside" it and the only escape is if the object is removed or you're pushed out. 

Is there any way to push? No. Is there a way the player could help? The player is at (3,7), a separate entity I don't control.

Let me try one more creative thing: maybe holding a direction while the game processes a "stuck" state eventually slides me. Let me hold left for a very long time (10 seconds).
